snippet.title: Lured In - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
OUT NOW on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4178020/Lured_In/

Run your own cozy aquarium! Travel far and wide to catch exotic fish. Put them on display for idle profits, or sell them for instant cash. Unlock research for new upgrades, and ascend for powerful bonuses. Customize your shop, character, and tanks to make your aquarium your own!
